name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - branch-*
      - dogfood-*
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: >-
    ${{ github.workflow }}-
    ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref || 'push' }}-
    ${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CACHE_BACKEND: s3

jobs:
  build-number:
    outputs:
      BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ steps.build-number.outputs.BUILD_NUMBER }}
    runs-on: sonar-xs
    name: Get build number
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: SonarSource/ci-github-actions/get-build-number@c3a85ac3a2f67f86966e2fb1fdf9a7c1bdc997dc # 2.2.0
        id: build-number

  build:
    runs-on: sonar-xs
    needs: build-number
    name: Build
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: write
    env:
      BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ needs.build-number.outputs.BUILD_NUMBER }}
    outputs:
      build_number: ${{ steps.build.outputs.build_number }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9149ea85001c7435d5a66bb127d6a1b6227cb0a5 # v5.0.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.21
      - uses: SonarSource/ci-github-actions/build-maven@c3a85ac3a2f67f86966e2fb1fdf9a7c1bdc997dc # 2.2.0
        id: build
        with:
          sonar-platform: none
          deploy-pull-request: true
          artifactory-reader-role: private-reader
          artifactory-deployer-role: qa-deployer
          repox-url: https://repox-internal.dev.sonar.build
          maven-args: -T 1C -P dist-no-arch,dist-windows_x64,dist-linux_x64,dist-linux_aarch64,dist-macosx_x64,dist-macosx_aarch64 -Dmaven.test.skip=true -Dsonar.skip=true
      - name: Config Maven (cache setup)
        run: |
          mvn -B -e -V -Pits dependency:go-offline # populate cache including ITs deps too

  test-linux:
    needs: [ build-number, build ]
    runs-on: sonar-m
    name: Test (Linux, Sonar Next)
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: write
    env:
      BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ needs.build-number.outputs.BUILD_NUMBER }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9149ea85001c7435d5a66bb127d6a1b6227cb0a5 # v5.0.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.21
      - name: Install dotnet for Omnisharp tests
        run: |
          mise use dotnet@8
      - name: Vault
        id: secrets
        uses: SonarSource/vault-action-wrapper@a7fa5fd4a4e4e0f2593f6137c0812cac196cf4ce # 3.7.0
        with:
          secrets: |
            development/kv/data/next url | NEXT_URL;
            development/kv/data/next token | NEXT_TOKEN;
      - name: Cache Sonar Scanner artifacts
        id: sonar-scanner-cache
        uses: SonarSource/ci-github-actions/cache@c3a85ac3a2f67f86966e2fb1fdf9a7c1bdc997dc # 2.2.0
        with:
          path: ~/.sonar/cache
          key: sonar-scanner-${{ runner.os }}
      - uses: SonarSource/ci-github-actions/config-maven@c3a85ac3a2f67f86966e2fb1fdf9a7c1bdc997dc # 2.2.0
        id: config
        with:
          artifactory-reader-role: private-reader
          repox-url: https://repox-internal.dev.sonar.build
      - name: Run tests
        env:
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ fromJSON(steps.secrets.outputs.vault).NEXT_URL }}
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ fromJSON(steps.secrets.outputs.vault).NEXT_TOKEN }}
          PROJECT

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
